BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to newborn screening fees; amending RCW 70.83.023;and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 70.83.023 and 2007 c 259 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department has the authority to collect a fee of ((three)) sixdollars and ((fifty)) forty cents from the parents or other responsibleparty of each infant screened for congenital disorders as defined bythe state board of health under RCW 70.83.020 to fund specialty clinicsthat provide treatment services for or education and outreach to thosewith the defined disorders. The fee may be collected through thefacility where a screening specimen is obtained.
